challenges: Scaling Budget Ambition Without Breaking Indie ROIC Discipline: Expanding from $8M-$18M auteur features into $35M-$50M+ theatrical events (e.g., Civil War, Marty Supreme) while preserving foreign pre-sales downside protection and avoiding major-studio P&A bloat.

Algorithmic Social Discovery vs. Theatrical Box-Office Conversion: Converting massive TikTok, Letterboxd, Instagram, and YouTube trailer engagement into opening-weekend theatrical foot traffic amid shrinking theatrical windows.
AAA24 Direct-to-Fan LTV & Drop Economics: Scaling recurring AAA24 subscription retention, limited-edition screenplay books, vinyl scores, and streetwear drops without diluting cult brand scarcity.

Multi-Project Post-Production & Prestige TV Throughput: Coordinating simultaneous VFX turnovers, ACES DI color grading, Dolby Atmos mixes, and E&O chain-of-title clearances across 15-20 annual film/TV releases with a lean ~200-person organization.

Pay-1 Streaming & Foreign Territory Valuation Shifts: Navigating tightening SVOD licensing minimums and international distributor pre-sales selectivity across AFM, EFM Berlin, and Cannes Marche du Film.
